kl_pace_analysis.model: trigger CE on one labelled slot from ~uniform over 9 slots (8 candidates + none); cap-limited lower bound N >= FisherRao(start, target) / sqrt(2 kappa) (small-step KL ~ s^2/2), all labelled contexts moving together
kl_pace_analysis.empirical: clean2 bank CE 2.13 (u1) -> 1.21 (u6) -> 0.39 (u12) = p_label 0.12 -> 0.30 -> 0.68, i.e. ~0.003-0.008 nats per update, 5-15x BELOW the 0.045 cap: the pace was optimizer-limited (imitation_epochs 5 Adam steps, lr 3e-4), not cap-limited. At that pace p=0.8 needs ~12-20 updates (matches LEARNAUDIT's 12+) regardless of the cap; raising the cap 2x/3x only helps if the per-update optimizer budget can also move further. Approximate (different contexts per run; KL is the mean over all CE records).
